column1: # The env, wrappers and git-options prefixes contain 65 tokens each. The
# env-long and wrappers-long prefixes contain 128, which is past the 96-token
# point where dcg's evaluator-side `executables` resolution gives up: with that
# scope declared, every rule here answered ALLOW beyond it. test/run.sh
# enforces a 200 ms analysis budget for every case.
